content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make your house a better place for animals, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Research local wildlife habitat requirements (3 hours)
Step 2. Purchase non-toxic wood sealant (45 minutes)
Step 3. Draft a layout for the backyard bird sanctuary (2 hours)
Step 4. Install a solar-powered fountain pump (1 hour)
Step 5. Dig a trench for the pond liner (5 hours)
Step 6. Measure the balcony for safety netting (30 minutes)
Step 7. Clear debris from the north garden corner (4 hours)
Step 8. Level the ground for a hedgehog house (2 hours)
Step 9. Place dry leaves and straw inside the hedgehog house (15 minutes)
Step 10. Order a pre-formed pond basin (20 minutes)
Step 11. Compare eco-friendly paint brands online (1 hour)
Step 12. Buy specialized hardware for pet-safe window screens (30 minutes)
Step 13. Assemble a multi-level cat climbing wall (3 hours)
Step 14. Plant catnip and valerian in indoor pots (45 minutes)
Step 15. Buy organic wildflower seeds (20 minutes)
Step 16. Install a motion-activated wildlife camera (1 hour)
Step 17. Source reclaimed timber for a catio frame (2 days)
Step 18. Secure the protective netting to the exterior hooks (2 hours)
Step 19. Consult a veterinarian about indoor enrichment (1 hour)
Step 20. Download a map of native plant species (10 minutes)
Step 21. Set up a dedicated research station in the home office (1 hour)
Step 22. Build the wooden hedgehog shelter (4 hours)
Step 23. Install wall-mounted feeding bowls (30 minutes)
Step 24. Sketch the dimensions for the catio floor (1 hour)
Step 25. Fill the pond with water and aquatic plants (3 hours)
Step 26. Construct the catio structural frame (1 day)
Step 27. Arrange cozy pet beds in the new sunroom (30 minutes)
Step 28. Designate a quiet "no-human" zone for pets (2 hours)
Step 29. Drive to the hardware store (30 minutes)
Step 30. Install a bird bath on the balcony (45 minutes)
Step 31. Apply the non-toxic sealant to the exterior wood (6 hours)
Step 32. Cut the reclaimed timber to size (3 hours)
Step 33. Hang scratching posts on the wall studs (1 hour)
Step 34. Read a book on animal behavior (1 week)
Step 35. Clear out the spare room for animal activities (4 hours)
Step 36. Fit the pet-safe screens into the window frames (2 hours)
Step 37. Inspect the backyard fence for gaps (1 hour)
Step 38. Attach the wire mesh to the catio frame (5 hours)
Step 39. Position the fountain in the bird bath (15 minutes)
Step 40. Install the pond basin into the ground (4 hours)
